<Badge color="blue">Beta</Badge>


<Note>
**Beta**

Server tools are currently in beta. The API and behavior may change.
</Note>

The `openrouter:image_generation` server tool enables any model to generate images from text prompts. When the model determines it needs to create an image, it calls the tool with a description. OpenRouter executes the image generation and returns the result to the model.

## How It Works

1. You include `{ "type": "openrouter:image_generation" }` in your `tools` array.
2. Based on the user's request, the model decides whether image generation is needed and crafts a prompt.
3. OpenRouter generates the image using the configured model (defaults to `openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare`).
4. The generated image URL is returned to the model.
5. The model incorporates the image into its response. It may generate multiple images in a single request if needed.

## Quick Start

<CodeGroup>

```typescript title="TypeScript" expandable lines
const response = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    Authorization: 'Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: 'openai/gpt-5.2',
    input: 'Create an image of a futuristic city at sunset',
    tools: [
      { type: 'openrouter:image_generation' }
    ]
  }),
});

const data = await response.json();
const message = [...data.output].reverse().find((item: { type: string }) => item.type === 'message');
console.log(message?.content.find((part: { type: string; text?: string }) => part.type === 'output_text')?.text);

// The generated image is a separate output item, as a data: URL
const images = data.output.filter(
  (item: { type: string; result?: string }) => item.type === 'openrouter:image_generation',
);
for (const image of images) {
  if (image.result) {
    // Print a short preview; the full data URL is very long
    console.log(`${image.result.slice(0, 64)}... (${image.result.length} chars)`);
  }
}

```

```python title="Python" expandable lines
import requests

response = requests.post(
  "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses",
  headers={
    "Authorization": f"Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  json={
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.2",
    "input": "Create an image of a futuristic city at sunset",
    "tools": [
      {"type": "openrouter:image_generation"}
    ]
  }
)

data = response.json()
message = next((item for item in reversed(data["output"]) if item["type"] == "message"), None)
text = next(
  (part["text"] for part in message["content"] if part["type"] == "output_text"),
  None,
) if message else None
if text:
  print(text)

# The generated image is a separate output item, as a data: URL
images = [
  item for item in data["output"] if item["type"] == "openrouter:image_generation"
]
for image in images:
  if image.get("result"):
    print(image["result"])
if not text and not any(image.get("result") for image in images):
  raise RuntimeError("Response contained neither text nor a generated image")
```

```bash title="cURL" lines
curl https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.2",
    "input": "Create an image of a futuristic city at sunset",
    "tools": [
      {"type": "openrouter:image_generation"}
    ]
  }'
```

```go title="Go" lines
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"model": "openai/gpt-5.2",
		"input": "Create an image of a futuristic city at sunset",
		"tools": []map[string]any{
			{"type": "openrouter:image_generation"},
		},
	})
	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("OPENROUTER_API_KEY"))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		panic("API error: " + resp.Status)
	}

	var data struct {
		Output []struct {
			Type    string `json:"type"`
			Result  string `json:"result"`
			Content []struct {
				Type string `json:"type"`
				Text string `json:"text"`
			} `json:"content"`
		} `json:"output"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&data); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	for i := len(data.Output) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if data.Output[i].Type == "message" {
			for _, part := range data.Output[i].Content {
				if part.Type == "output_text" {
					fmt.Println(part.Text)
					break
				}
			}
			break
		}
	}

	// The generated image is a separate output item, as a data: URL
	for _, item := range data.Output {
		if item.Type == "openrouter:image_generation" && item.Result != "" {
			// Print a short preview; the full data URL is very long
			fmt.Printf("%s... (%d chars)\n", item.Result[:min(64, len(item.Result))], len(item.Result))
		}
	}
}

```

</CodeGroup>

```text title="Output"
Here’s an image of a futuristic city at sunset:

![Futuristic city at sunset](/mnt/data/0.png)
data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAABogAAAOtCAIAAAA95H... (4111094 chars)
```

## Configuration

The image generation tool accepts optional `parameters` to customize the output:

```json lines
{
  "type": "openrouter:image_generation",
  "parameters": {
    "model": "openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare",
    "quality": "high",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "background": "opaque",
    "output_format": "png"
  }
}
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `model` | string | `openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare` | Which image generation model to use. See [available image models](https://openrouter.ai/models?output_modalities=image). |
| `quality` | string | N/A | Image quality level (model-dependent, e.g. `"low"`, `"medium"`, `"high"`) |
| `size` | string | N/A | Image dimensions (e.g. `"1024x1024"`, `"512x512"`) |
| `aspect_ratio` | string | N/A | Aspect ratio (e.g. `"16:9"`, `"1:1"`, `"4:3"`) |
| `background` | string | N/A | Background style (e.g. `"transparent"`, `"opaque"`) |
| `output_format` | string | N/A | Output format (e.g. `"png"`, `"jpeg"`, `"webp"`) |
| `output_compression` | number | N/A | Compression level (0-100) for lossy formats |
| `moderation` | string | N/A | Content moderation level (e.g. `"auto"`, `"low"`) |

All parameters except `model` are passed directly to the underlying image generation API. Available options depend on the specific model being used.

## Response

The generated image is returned as its own item in the response `output` array, before the model's `message`:

```json lines
{
  "type": "openrouter:image_generation",
  "id": "ig_abc123",
  "status": "completed",
  "result": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "imageUrl": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "prompt": "A futuristic city at sunset"
}
```

When the model calls the image generation tool, it receives a response like:

```json lines
{
  "status": "ok",
  "imageUrl": "data:image/png;base64,..."
}
```

If generation fails, the response includes an error:

```json lines
{
  "status": "error",
  "error": "Generation failed due to content policy"
}
```

## Example with Parameters

Pass `parameters` on the tool entry to configure it:

<CodeGroup>

```typescript title="TypeScript" lines
const response = await fetch('https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    Authorization: 'Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: 'openai/gpt-5.2',
    input: 'Generate an image of a mountain landscape',
    tools: [
      {
        type: 'openrouter:image_generation',
        parameters: { quality: 'high' }
      }
    ]
  }),
});

const data = await response.json();
const message = [...data.output].reverse().find((item: { type: string }) => item.type === 'message');
const text = message?.content.find(
  (part: { type: string; text?: string }) => part.type === 'output_text',
)?.text;
if (text) console.log(text);

// The generated image is a separate output item, as a data: URL
const images = data.output.filter(
  (item: { type: string; result?: string }) => item.type === 'openrouter:image_generation',
);
for (const image of images) {
  if (image.result) {
    // Print a short preview; the full data URL is very long
    console.log(`${image.result.slice(0, 64)}... (${image.result.length} chars)`);
  }
}
if (!text && !images.some((image: { result?: string }) => image.result)) {
  throw new Error('Response contained neither text nor a generated image');
}
```

```go title="Go" lines
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"model": "openai/gpt-5.2",
		"input": "Generate an image of a mountain landscape",
		"tools": []map[string]any{
			{
				"type":       "openrouter:image_generation",
				"parameters": map[string]any{"quality": "high"},
			},
		},
	})
	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("OPENROUTER_API_KEY"))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		panic("API error: " + resp.Status)
	}

	var data struct {
		Output []struct {
			Type    string `json:"type"`
			Result  string `json:"result"`
			Content []struct {
				Type string `json:"type"`
				Text string `json:"text"`
			} `json:"content"`
		} `json:"output"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&data); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}

	text := ""
	for i := len(data.Output) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if data.Output[i].Type == "message" {
			for _, part := range data.Output[i].Content {
				if part.Type == "output_text" {
					text = part.Text
					break
				}
			}
			break
		}
	}
	if text != "" {
		fmt.Println(text)
	}

	hasImage := false
	for _, item := range data.Output {
		if item.Type == "openrouter:image_generation" && item.Result != "" {
			fmt.Println(item.Result)
			hasImage = true
		}
	}
	if text == "" && !hasImage {
		panic("Response contained neither text nor a generated image")
	}
}

```

```bash title="cURL" lines
curl -sS https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai/gpt-5.2",
    "input": "Generate an image of a mountain landscape",
    "tools": [
      {
        "type": "openrouter:image_generation",
        "parameters": {"quality": "high"}
      }
    ]
  }' | jq -r '
    [ (.output | map(select(.type == "message")) | last | .content[]? | select(.type == "output_text") | .text),
      # The generated image is a data: URL; print a short preview since the full value is very long
      (.output[] | select(.type == "openrouter:image_generation") | .result // empty
        | "\(.[0:64])... (\(length) chars)") ]
    | if length == 0 then error("Response contained neither text nor a generated image") else .[] end'

```

</CodeGroup>

```text title="Output"
data:image/png;base64,
…[192000 chars clipped]…

```

## Pricing

Image generation pricing depends on the underlying model used:

- **openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare** (default): See [model page](https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-image-2.6-flare)
- Other models: See the [image models list](https://openrouter.ai/models?output_modalities=image) on OpenRouter

The cost is in addition to standard LLM token costs for processing the request and response.
